programme.title: Toda A Verdade Líbano: Sob Fogo Cruzado
programme.desc: O Líbano está a ser dilacerado por uma guerra fora do seu controlo.À sombra da guerra entre os EUA, Israel e Irão, o Líbano mergulhou numa crise. As Forças de Defesa Israelitas lançaram uma invasão terrestre após ataques com rockets do Hezbollah, uma milícia aliada do Irão com base no Líbano, nos primeiros dias da guerra. Nos meses que se seguiram, as FDI tomaram e ocuparam 6% do território libanês e destruíram casas e edifícios, desalojando dezenas de milhares de libaneses.

programme.title: The Collective
programme.desc: A group of righteous assassins known as The Collective takes aim at a human trafficking ring that's backed by a network of untouchable billionaires.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: A dangerous storm forces Pilot Brodie Torrance to land his plane on a war-torn island. When his passengers are taken hostage, the only person Brodie can rely on is an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: After being betrayed and left for dead in Italy, a thief and his crew travel to L.A. with a plan to steal back their fortune and bring down their double-crossing former ally.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo mounts a one-man mission to rescue his friend Colonel Trautman from the invading Soviet forces in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre
programme.desc: Super spy Orson Fortune and his team of operatives must recruit a Hollywood star to help them on a globe-trotting undercover mission to prevent the sale of a deadly new weapons technology.

programme.title: Border Hunters
programme.desc: Former spy Abraham Woodhill enlists an imprisoned ex-operative for a high-stakes mission that takes him through Mexico's jungles, villages, and cartel strongholds.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: Locked up for a minor crime, 19 year old JR quickly learns the harsh realities of prison life. One of Australia's most notorious criminals offers him protection, but it comes with a price.

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: After a fatal incident sends him on a rampant path of destruction, a champion boxer enters the hardest battle of his life as he struggles to win back the trust of those he loves.

programme.title: The Death and Life of Bobby Z
programme.desc: An incarcerated former Marine gets a chance to earn his freedom. All he needs to do is impersonate a recently deceased drug kingpin.

programme.title: Valiant One
programme.desc: Trapped behind enemy lines with no hope of rescue, a reluctant army sergeant must lead his unit to safety while being pursued by North Korean soldiers.

programme.title: Bad Man
programme.desc: After a drug-related murder shakes his small town, Deputy Sam Evans finds himself working with undercover agent Bobby Gaines, a hotshot narcotics officer who doesn't play by the rules.

programme.title: The Last Gunfight
programme.desc: In a ruthless underground tournament, the world's top assassins fight to the death. However, amongst them is a rogue crew with their own lethal agenda.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Homeless and on the run from a military court martial, a damaged ex-special forces soldier seizes an opportunity to assume another man’s identity - transforming into a vigilante in the process.

programme.title: Cult Killer
programme.desc: A private investigator is forced into a dangerous alliance with a killer to uncover a town's grisly secrets and bring justice to its victims.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: Kyle Reese is sent back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor. But when the timeline fractures, Reese is thrust into a new and unfamiliar version of the past.

programme.title: Desperation Road
programme.desc: In a tough Mississippi town, a homeless single mum and an ex-con just out of prison find themselves on a collision course, tortured by the mistakes of their past and bound by a secret that keeps them running.

programme.title: Dead Man Down
programme.desc: The right hand man to a New York crime lord is seduced and blackmailed by a woman seeking retribution.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: During WWII, battle-hardened army sergeant Don 'Wardaddy' Collier leads the crew of a Sherman tank on a mission behind enemy lines. Outnumbered and outgunned, the soldiers face overwhelming odds as they strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: The Grey
programme.desc: When their plane crashes in the Alaskan wilderness, John Ottway must lead his team of oil-rig roughnecks through the icy elements as a pack of hungry wolves haunts their every step.

programme.title: Act of Valour
programme.desc: An elite team of Navy SEALs embark on a covert mission to recover a kidnapped CIA agent from a lethal terrorist cell. Filmed using a cast of real-life active-duty US Navy SEALs.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: A security expert agrees to take on one last job - breaking out of most high tech, ultra-secret prison on the planet.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: A film crew is taken hostage by an insane hunter and forced to accompany him on his quest to capture the world's largest - and deadliest - snake.

programme.title: DarkGame
programme.desc: A determined detective races to stop a twisted game show on the dark web, where captives are forced to compete for their lives.

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: When a top-secret weapon falls into mercenary hands, a wild card CIA agent joins forces with three international operatives on a lethal mission to retrieve it.

programme.title: Catwoman
programme.desc: In Gotham City, a mild-mannered graphic designer stumbles upon a dark secret. Transformed into Catwoman, with the strength, speed and ultra-keen sense of a cat, she becomes a fearless vigilante.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: An ex-special forces soldier is forced back into the field to save his niece, who has been kidnapped in South America. As the fight intensifies, he and his team discover that her disappearance is part of a something much bigger.

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Cal is a by-the-book police officer and Marine Corps reservist. When his reckless younger brother is arrested, Cal must decide how far he'll go to fight for his family.

programme.title: RED
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses is living a quiet life alone - until the day a hit squad shows up to kill him. Frank must reunite his old team in a last-ditch effort to survive, and find out who wants him dead.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: A CIA recruit is caught in a dangerous web of intrigue and espionage as he fights to stop a devastating plot against the United States.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: An ancient war between two robot clans - the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons - arrives on Earth, placing all humanity at risk. Teenager Sam Witwicky finds himself caught in the middle when his new car turns out to be a robot in disguise.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: An ex-Marine enlists his father to help train him for the biggest MMA tournament ever held. When his estranged brother also steps into the ring, their family must finally confront their past and the forces that drove them apart.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Two years after saving the world, Sam has gone to college and the Autobots are trying to make a home for themselves on earth. But a Decepticon, named 'The Fallen' returns on a mission of vengeance.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Venice
programme.desc: To get his beloved dog back, L.A. private eye Steve Ford teams up with his depressive best friend, his lazy assistant, and a diabolical drug dealer.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: Four years after being gunned down at her own wedding, a former assassin wakes from her coma, vowing to seek vengeance on all those who betrayed her.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: A notorious group of criminals baffle police by pulling off elaborate heists. But on their biggest job yet - with $20 million at stake - their plans are interrupted by a hard-boiled detective hell-bent on solving the case.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: A pair of undercover Miami detectives - one a wild bachelor and the other a family man - must switch lives while working on a major narcotics case.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Trash-talking Miami Detectives Lowrey and Burnett must try to stop a ruthless drug lord who is determined to expand his empire, killing anyone in his way.

programme.title: Prisoner of War
programme.desc: During WWII, British RAF Wing Commander James Wright is caught and imprisoned in a Japanese internment camp. Wright must not only survive, but also fight in brutal martial arts matches organized by his captors for their entertainment.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top bodyguard Michael Bryce gets a chaotic new client: notorious hitman Darius Kincaid. With enemies on their tail, they must put aside their differences to get Darius to court alive and on time.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock develops superhuman strength and power when his body merges with an alien symbiote. Twisted, dark, and fuelled by rage, the creature tries to control the new and dangerous abilities that Eddie finds so intoxicating.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: When a deranged killer also becomes host to an alien symbiote, Eddie Brock and Venom must put aside their differences to stop his reign of terror.

programme.title: Dirty
programme.desc: Over the course of one day, a gangbanger-turned-cop is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue.

programme.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Bodyguard Michael Bryce continues his friendship with hitman Darius Kincaid as they embark on another life-threatening mission - protecting Darius's even more volatile wife, the infamous international con artist Sonia.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: When an event from Earth's past erupts into the present day, it threatens to bring a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save us.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Two brothers grow up to be very different people - one a business owner and one a petty mobster. When one brother is kidnapped and held for a ransom, the other must risk everything to save him.

programme.title: Three Kings
programme.desc: At the end of the Gulf War, a small band of American soldiers seek adventure and fortune by attempting to steal a huge cache of gold hidden somewhere in the desert.

programme.title: Revenge of the Green Dragons
programme.desc: A Chinese emigrant and his best friend rise through the ranks of one of New York's most-powerful street gangs.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: A malevolent force within a supernatural fog traps a remote seaside community. It's seeking revenge against the descendants of the town's founders.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: A bank teller anticipates a robbery and steals most of the cash himself. When the deception is exposed, a chilling game of cat and mouse ensues.

programme.title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
programme.desc: An alien travels to Earth in search of water for his drought-stricken planet. However, a woman and greed of other men create complications.

programme.title: A Man, A Woman And A Bank
programme.desc: Two men plan to rob a bank with the help of a computer. However, a photographer complicates their daring scheme.

programme.title: Alive
programme.desc: Stranded after a plane crash in the snow-swept Andes mountains, members of a Uruguayan rugby team must resort to desperate measures to survive. Based on a harrowing true story.

programme.title: The Deer Hunter
programme.desc: The lives of three small-town steel mill workers are changed forever after fighting in the Vietnam War, the experience leaving them with terrible physical and psychological wounds.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: While in a struggle to save the Sorceress of Castle Greyskull, He-Man clashes with Skeletor to recover the extremely powerful Cosmic Key.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: The aging patriarch of a New York crime family transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son, Michael Corleone, pulling him into the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal.

programme.title: Lord of the Flies
programme.desc: After their plane crash lands on a desert island, a group of schoolboys find themselves deprived of adult supervision.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: In the 1960s, a young American soldier arrives in Vietnam, and discovers he must battle not only the Viet Cong, but also the fear, exhaustion and intense anger growing within him.

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A timid shop clerk finds his chance for success and romance with the help of a giant man-eating plant.

programme.title: Rushmore
programme.desc: An eccentric youth enlists the help of a local tycoon to win the affections of his schoolteacher, only to find his mentor has designs on her too.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: In the summer of 1963, 17-year-old Frances \"Baby\" Houseman vacations with her parents at a resort, where she meets Johnny the hotel dance instructor, who is as experienced at life as Baby is naive.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Under the guidance of a master of the martial arts, a teenage boy develops the faith and self-confidence to overcome tremendous odds.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen is fired and rushes out to catch a train home, her life splits into two parallel realities. In one world, she catches the train; in the other, she misses it - one split second leads her on two different journeys of the heart.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: After learning that a missing kid has been killed near their rural homes, four Oregon boys decide to go see the body. Along the way, they learn about themselves, the meaning of friendship and the need to stand up for what is right.

programme.title: Three Days of the Condor
programme.desc: When a CIA intelligence officer finds all his co-workers dead, he must outwit those responsible and figure out who he can really trust.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: A chance meeting with a beguiling woman shatters the dreams of a young baseballer. Sixteen years later, he is given another shot at the big leagues.

programme.title: Reservoir Dogs
programme.desc: They were perfect strangers, assembled to pull off the perfect crime. Then their simple robbery explodes into a bloody ambush, and the ruthless killers realise one of them is a police informer. But which one?

programme.title: Clockwise
programme.desc: Headmaster Brian Stimpson is fanatical about being on time. But when he boards the wrong train on his way to a conference he finds himself in a nightmarish journey of misunderstandings, ex-girlfriends, unruly Sixth Formers and even the police.

programme.title: The Lavender Hill Mob
programme.desc: A bank clerk and his eccentric neighbour plan to smuggle a shipment of gold bars out of the country by recasting them as miniature Eiffel Towers.

programme.title: Sands of Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Marine Sergeant John Stryker is despised by his recruits for his brutal training methods. But they will need all of Stryker's battle tactics if they want to survive one of the bloodiest engagements of the war: the Battle of Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: A dogged sheriff is determined to bring justice to a rancher and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree.

programme.title: One From the Heart
programme.desc: On the anniversary of their five-year romance, Hank and Frannie decide to go their separate ways. Over one night in Las Vegas, they each seek comfort elsewhere. Featuring songs by Tom Waits and Crystal Gale.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Mr Miyagi takes a new pupil under his wing - a troubled adolescent girl.

programme.title: Steel Magnolias
programme.desc: A tight-knit group of Southern belles gather for company and support at a Louisiana beauty parlour.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be grows increasingly suspicious that her overfriendly elderly neighbours are hatching a satanic plot against her and her unborn baby.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Daniel and Mr. Miyagi hope for a peaceful life, but their serenity is shattered when Daniel is blackmailed into competing against the vicious \"Bad Boy of Karate\".

programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The history of two generations of crime unfolds. A young Vito Corleone does what he can to survive in Sicily and Hell's Kitchen. In 1950s New York, his son Michael tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Daniel accompanies Mr. Miyagi to Japan to see his dying father and confront an old rival. While he's there, Daniel inadvertently makes an enemy of his own.

programme.title: The Ladykillers
programme.desc: A hapless gang of criminals have their unlawful plans derailed by a little old lady who runs a boarding house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The uniquely macabre Addams Family and their kooky household are surprised by a visit from their long lost Uncle Fester. But is Uncle Fester really everything he seems?

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Detective Rixley relentlessly pursues a gang of outlaws led by Jesse James and Cole Younger.

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Johnny Hawk provides safe passage for wagons heading West, but he lets his guard down when he falls for the daughter of a Native American chief.

programme.title: Richard III

programme.title: School For Scoundrels
programme.desc: A chronic loser hopes that a school that teaches one-upmanship will enable him to embarrass a rival and woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: A Time To Kill
programme.desc: A brave lawyer takes on the trial of his life, as he attempts to save a scorned father who's accused of murdering two men.

programme.title: Kind Hearts And Coronets
programme.desc: A downtrodden relative of the Duke D'Ascoyne plots to inherit the title by murdering the eight other heirs ahead of him in the line of succession.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: Competing for control of the French Riviera, a high class con man and a low brow swindler decide to settle their rivalry with a bet - who can scam a young American heiress out of $50,000 first.

programme.title: The Producers

programme.title: Miles Davis, John Scofield, Darryl Jones & Robert Irving III
programme.sub-title: Miles Davis Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1985, legendary American trumpeter Miles Davis gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Davis' influence on the course of jazz cannot be overstated, as he helped shape bebop, modal jazz, hard bop, and electric jazz, and nurtured the talent of influential musicians, including that of seminal saxophonist John Coltrane.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.sub-title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini's concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini's extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer's contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Milky Chance
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album "Blossom". And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!

programme.title: Michael Bolton
programme.sub-title: Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without You?", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Matchbox Twenty performs their hits including "Bright Lights" , "Parade" , "You're So Real", and many more…
